title: Citropten Ameliorates Osteoclastogenesis Related to MAPK and PLCgamma/Ca(2+) Signaling Pathways through the Regulation of Amyloid Beta.
authors: Trang, Nguyen Minh; Kim, Eun-Nam; Pham, Thi Hoa; Jeong, Gil-Saeng
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柠檬油素通过MAPK和PLCgamma/Ca(2+)信号通路抑制破骨细胞生成，分子对接仅针对钙信号通路蛋白，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: Osteoporosis and Alzheimer's disease are typical types of dementia in seniors, which share common risk factors. Previous studies have shown that citizens with osteoporosis are more likely than healthy individuals to be at risk of Alzheimer's disease. Citropten, found in Citrus aurantifolia, has been reported to have several pharmacological activities; however, its antiosteoclastogenic activity remains unknown. Here, receptor activator nuclear factor kappaB ligand (RANKL)-induced osteoclast differentiation, formation, and function in the presence of amyloid beta (Abeta) were attenuated by citropten in the RAW 264.7 cell line. The expression of osteoclast specific genes and proteins indicated that citropten pretreatment lowers the MAPK and PLCgamma/Ca(2+) signaling pathways. Molecular docking simulations revealed that citropten interacts with the active sites of proteins in the calcium signaling pathway, which have negative binding affinities. These findings indicate that, through Abeta regulation, the RANKL-induced osteoclast can be suppressed by citropten, suggesting that citropten is a potential candidate for treating osteoclastogenesis-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 骨质疏松症和阿尔茨海默病是老年人中典型的痴呆类型，它们具有共同的危险因素。既往研究表明，患有骨质疏松症的公民比健康个体更易面临阿尔茨海默病的风险。柠檬苦素（Citropten），发现于酸橙（Citrus aurantifolia）中，已被报道具有多种药理活性；然而，其抗破骨细胞生成活性仍未知。在此，在RAW 264.7细胞系中，受体激活核因子κB配体（RANKL）诱导的破骨细胞分化、形成和功能在淀粉样β（Abeta）存在下被柠檬苦素减弱。破骨细胞特异性基因和蛋白的表达表明，柠檬苦素预处理降低了MAPK和PLCγ/Ca(2+)信号通路。分子对接模拟揭示，柠檬苦素与钙信号通路中蛋白质的活性位点相互作用，并具有负结合亲和力。这些发现表明，通过Abeta调节，RANKL诱导的破骨细胞可被柠檬苦素抑制，提示柠檬苦素是治疗破骨细胞生成相关疾病的潜在候选药物。
